Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Travel & transport

visa noun

also entry visa, travel visa

our formation

ingressūs diplōma

phrase: diplōma, diplōmatis n., with the genitive of ingressus

a permit to enter

Our description, on the pattern of the passport, commeātūs diplōma (Traupman 217): a diplōma is an official permit (see licence), and ingressus an entering, used by Pliny of his arrival in his province (in ipsō ingressū meō, Plin. Ep. ad Traj. 17.4, in Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • ingrediendī licentia — leave to enter

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. passport: visa

    Morgan–Owens marks it with a query.

See also passport, licence, border.

SourcesLewis & Short: diploma · Lewis & Short: ingressus · Lewis & Short: licentia
